$comment: Hand-maintained: packages shadcn/ui code commonly uses that depend on the DOM and do not run in React Native. The imports pass flags imports of these with a TODO.

vaul.reason: vaul (Drawer) is built on the DOM and does not run on native.
vaul.suggestion: Use Tamagui `Sheet` for a drawer that works on web and native.

sonner.reason: sonner (toasts) renders DOM elements and does not run on native.

recharts.reason: recharts renders SVG through the DOM and does not run on native.
recharts.suggestion: Use a React Native charting library (e.g. victory-native) for native, or keep charts web-only in a `.web.tsx` file.

next-themes.reason: next-themes reads and writes the DOM (`document`, `localStorage`) and does not run on native.
next-themes.suggestion: Switch themes with Tamagui's `TamaguiProvider defaultTheme` / `Theme` and the platform color scheme.

@dnd-kit/core.reason: @dnd-kit uses DOM pointer events and does not run on native.
@dnd-kit/core.suggestion: Use react-native-gesture-handler/reanimated based drag and drop on native, or keep this web-only.

@dnd-kit/sortable.reason: @dnd-kit uses DOM pointer events and does not run on native.
@dnd-kit/sortable.suggestion: Use react-native-gesture-handler/reanimated based drag and drop on native, or keep this web-only.

@dnd-kit/modifiers.reason: @dnd-kit uses DOM pointer events and does not run on native.

@dnd-kit/utilities.reason: @dnd-kit uses DOM pointer events and does not run on native.

next/link.reason: next/link renders an `<a>` for the Next.js router and does not run on native.
next/link.suggestion: Use your cross-platform router's link (e.g. Expo Router or One `Link`).

next/image.reason: next/image is specific to Next.js on web.
